posts.text: Asiatiske gass priser opptil  5 års ATH. Gir et håp om at TD3C raten snart snur, legg merke til i linken at en liknende dupp i raten som vi har nå  var når den gikk over 1,2 mill nivået  Asian LNG prices are SKYROCKETING: Asian LNG spot prices surged to $30.4 per million British thermal units, the highest since December 2022. This is TRIPLE the levels seen before the Iran war, amid attacks on energy vessels in the Middle East that threaten supplies. The war has trapped most Qatari LNG production behind the Strait of Hormuz, disrupting supplies from a country that previously accounted for ~20% of global LNG supply. As a result, Asian buyers are increasingly competing for expensive spot cargoes as contracted deliveries fall short, just as demand rises ahead of the Northern Hemisphere winter. This is intensifying competition with Europe, where gas storage is only 75% full, compared with the 5-year seasonal average of 89%. The unprecedented energy crunch is driving up household electricity bills and fueling inflation across the globe. https://www.reuters.com/business/energy/asian-refiners-use-smaller-tankers-buy-delivered-crude-freight-rates-soar-2026-10-20/
